name: Gretex Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Gretex Industries Ltd is in the business of trading of musical instruments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is the Sole authorized distributor 
of Musical Instruments, Professional Audio
 & Audio Visual products in Eastern & North 
Eastern India for globally renowned brands.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.6%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.58 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
